review-rusty re-invocation: NO-OP.

The Rust-idiom supplement already ran on this epic to current HEAD. The latest pass (verdict + confidence calibration filed 2026-05-14 14:34 UTC, re-run extension at 15:02 UTC) covered all 11 post-14:34 remediation commits up to and including 023a509 ('drop redundant intra-doc link target on MetadataFilterCondition'). Two new idiom findings (.37, .38) were filed in that re-run.

Verified the idiom surface is unchanged since that pass:
- git log on crate-jmap-metadata-server/ shows zero commits after 023a509 (14:59 UTC).
- 023a509 was the final commit of the 11-commit remediation series that the 15:02 UTC note explicitly enumerates as its scope.

Per the workspace bikeshedding rule and review-loop convergence rule, the idiom verdict (ACCEPTABLE) and confidence calibration (~88% chance of no further missed idiom issue in the post-14:34 delta) carry forward unchanged.

Idiom verdict (unchanged): ACCEPTABLE.
Idiom confidence (unchanged): ~88%.

Not running another rubric pass on identical source would be manufactured bikeshedding, exactly what the prompt's convergence/honesty rule prohibits.
